subject: spanish

moments.title: Borges's Ficciones
moments.body: Borges's stories shape global short fiction. He never wins the Nobel.
moments.takeaway: Influence and prizes do not always align.

moments.title: Cien anos de soledad
moments.body: Garcia Marquez's novel of Macondo defines magical realism for a generation.
moments.takeaway: A single novel can define a region's literary brand.

moments.title: Vargas Llosa wins Nobel
moments.body: Vargas Llosa's Nobel completes the Boom's institutional recognition.
moments.takeaway: Major literary movements can sustain decades.

now.title: Latin American literature today
now.body: Roberto Bolano (2666, 2004), Isabel Allende and Valeria Luiselli continue the tradition. Spanish-language fiction sells globally.

reflection: Spanish-language literature includes more Latin Americans than Spaniards.
